runtime.architecture: Modular monolith with strict module boundaries and future Kafka-backed extraction points

modules.name: identity
modules.responsibility: OTP login, token lifecycle, customer identity, admin identity, non-production UAT seed credentials

modules.name: location
modules.responsibility: Address capture, pincode coverage, zone and warehouse resolution

modules.name: category
modules.responsibility: saree-focused configuration source of truth

modules.name: storefront
modules.responsibility: Backend-owned customer home merchandising, product descriptions, DB-seeded reference catalog expansion, and media composition with reference-style SHRESTA content; collection counts and optional productBadgeFilters are computed from active product-card rows

modules.name: asset
modules.responsibility: Authorize canonical direct browser uploads to Cloudflare R2, generate immutable keys, verify completion with HEAD, expose custom-domain metadata, enforce product media limits, and perform explicit lifecycle deletion

modules.name: catalog
modules.responsibility: Product data, backend media asset keys, launch category modelling

modules.name: search
modules.responsibility: Inventory-aware discovery via PostgreSQL FTS in Phase 1 and Typesense in Phase 2

modules.name: cart
modules.responsibility: Redis-primary cart, item limits, server-priced cart views

modules.name: checkout
modules.responsibility: Server-side validation, price locks, reservation initiation, idempotency

modules.name: payment
modules.responsibility: Razorpay integration, webhook truth, reconciliation, fraud signals

modules.name: order
modules.responsibility: Authenticated idempotent customer order placement, immutable item snapshots, customer-owned summary/history reads, customer-visible status reads, lifecycle transitions

modules.name: inventory
modules.responsibility: No oversell, reservations, hard deductions, auditability

modules.name: logistics
modules.responsibility: Rider assignment, ETA, OTP delivery verification

modules.name: notification
modules.responsibility: FCM, SMS, email, retries, channel routing

modules.name: admin
modules.responsibility: Operations dashboard, store-scoped RBAC, audit logging

modules.name: admin-test-users
modules.responsibility: Governed storefront test accounts: change-request-gated create/delete, backend-minted static OTP (SHA-256 hash for login + one-time pending plaintext cleared on reveal), static-OTP login lane with dedicated rate limits, zero stock mutation, zero email/SMS, simulated Razorpay orders and refunds, aggregate exclusion

modules.name: recommendation
modules.responsibility: Rule-based Phase 1 recommendations, ML-compatible interfaces

modules.name: observability
modules.responsibility: SLOs, structured logs, metrics, alerts, incident response

modules.name: kv
modules.responsibility: Table-configurable KV-first aggregate reads with DB fallback

modules.name: mutation
modules.responsibility: Idempotent and locked mutating admin APIs

phaseEvolution.phase1: Railway, PostgreSQL, Redis, Spring events, PostgreSQL FTS, rule-based recommendations
phaseEvolution.phase2: Scale the existing Cloudflare R2/Vercel/VPS architecture only when measured demand requires it
phaseEvolution.phase3: EKS, Karpenter, KEDA, PgBouncer, ClickHouse, Flink, Feast, Milvus, city namespaces

boundaryRules: Controllers call application services, not repositories.
Modules communicate through public service interfaces and domain events, not cross-module repositories.
Payment, order, inventory, storefront, category, and asset mutations use explicit transactions and idempotency keys.
Customer order placement uses authenticated customer session context, Redis idempotency, and a per-customer mutation lock.
Admin mutations acquire Redis locks before DB writes and publish KV snapshots only after transaction commit.
Local/dev/UAT seed migrations may not be loaded by production profiles.
Image binaries may live only under seed/shresta-media for DEV object-storage seeding; runtime media uses the Cloudflare custom domain and one canonical R2 object.
Gradle check must include verifyNoRuntimeStaticMedia to prevent backend static media regressions.
Analytics and recommendations consume events/read models; they do not block checkout.
